# foreman_katello_lifecycle_environment (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "foreman_katello_lifecycle_environment" "library" {
  name = "Library"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) The name of the katello lifecycle environment to look up.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description of the lifecycle environment
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `label` (String) Label of the lifecycle environment
- `library` (Boolean) Whether this is the library lifecycle environment
- `organization_id` (Number) Organization ID
